usedFor: A left-behind Shopify cart queues a follow-up reminder in a Balsio team thread.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Scheduled Message” in Balsio
bestTemplate.why: A left-behind cart becomes a reminder at a time you set, sent through your Balsio account.

watchOut: “Create Scheduled Message” needs a thread ID and a date and time.
